environment.description: ASP.NET Core 7.0 API deployed on Azure App Service (Linux, B2 tier). Azure Key Vault with software-protected keys (Standard tier, not HSM-backed). The IKeyVaultService implementation uses Azure.Security.KeyVault.Keys.Cryptography.CryptographyClient with RBAC role 'Key Vault Crypto User' assigned to the App Service managed identity. No input normalization middleware. Default Kestrel configuration with no request filtering. The ACL store is Azure Cosmos DB with case-sensitive string comparison on the AllowedUsers field.
